keywords.rule: Prevents damage. All block is removed at the start of your next turn.
Restore HP, up to max HP.
At the start of the poisoned creature's turn, it loses HP equal to its Poison, then Poison goes down by 1.
Deals 25% less attack damage. Lasts the listed number of turns.
Takes 50% more attack damage. Lasts the listed number of turns.
Each attack hit deals +1 damage per Strength. Lasts the whole fight.
After playing, remove this card from your deck for the rest of the fight (it returns next fight).
Stays in play for the rest of the fight instead of going to the discard pile.
Hits every enemy in the fight.
Enemies show what they'll do next turn. Some cards (Parry) check it.
Choose a card from your hand to put in the discard pile.
